summary: Recommends explicitly setting the state parameter (present/absent) because defaults vary across modules.
questions: Should I always set state: present on modules?
Why specify state if the module has a default?

answer_card.title: Always set state explicitly
answer_card.answer_md: Many modules make `state` optional, but defaults differ between modules and some support several states. Explicitly writing `state: present` or `state: absent` makes playbooks and roles clearer.
